name: Orbit Quickshell
instructions: Read orbit-shell/README.md Architecture and the relevant source. Shared configuration belongs in config/OrbitConfiguration.qml; shared services in services/OrbitServices.qml; each monitor is composed by bar/OrbitMonitorSurface.qml. Widgets get explicit inputs. Keep appearance/timing in Appearance.qml and Behavior.qml. Preserve popup teardown and reactive QML bindings. Do not restart Orbit or run qs ipc automatically. No new service is needed for a widget-only feature.
validation: QML parser and lint errors, Bash/Python/JS syntax, configured task checks, sequential model review; legacy warnings retained as baseline
